subject.title: fix(sessions): use account names for direct display

question: Should `sessions.list` display and search configured channel-account names ahead of opaque direct-peer identifiers when no stronger session title exists?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and proof-positive, but it intentionally changes the identity users see and search for in existing direct-session rows; current main’s recent session-title work makes that precedence a maintainer product choice.

options.title: Accept account-name fallback
options.body: Keep the proposed fallback and precedence tests so multi-account direct sessions use readable configured account names when only an opaque peer id is available.

options.title: Retain opaque-peer fallback
options.body: Keep the current identifier-based fallback and close this direction if maintainers want direct peers, rather than channel accounts, to remain the final visible identity.

recommendation.title: Accept account-name fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed fallback and precedence tests so multi-account direct sessions use readable configured account names when only an opaque peer id is available.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main session-listing and gateway feature work makes steipete the most directly connected decision owner.
